text:
mira: Quick heads-up — CloudForge marketplace preview caught a driver mismatch on their AMI during CI smoke. Can we do a preflight alignment tomorrow?
juan: saw that, link to failing job?
mira: https://ci.redwood.com/runs/99321 — kernel oops when using CUDA 12.2 + our runtime compiled with cuBLAS v12.2.14. Logs show nvml init errors.
sam: not surprised if the AMI has mixed kernels. CloudForge pushed a newer kernel package. We should pin the driver in marketplace bundle.
li: +1 on pinning but prefer a range rather than single build. e.g. package.json note: 
```
"driver_compat": "nvidia-driver >= 535.0 && < 542.0"
```
That avoids single-build breakage.
ben: agree. But downstream SI installs (TandemSI) require exact deb for air-gapped installs. We need a parallel artifact: pinned-deb and floating-apt repo.
marketplace-team: FYI CloudForge PM asked for a rollback window and comms template.
mira: propose plan: 1) emergency hotfix AMI with pinned driver deb + verified kernel 5.15 LTS, 2) patch marketplace listing with compatibility matrix, 3) handoff notes to SIs. Who owns the hotfix AMI?
juan: eng-runtime can build hotfix AMI. I can own the build and smoke tests. Need someone to own partner comms and SI packaging.
sam: I can handle SI packaging + signed debs. Will prepare checksum manifest.
li: I can update the compatibility matrix in the marketplace listing and add a note about recommended kernel versions. Will also add an automatic fallback policy for our runtime to choose quantized variant if nvml fails.
ben: for rollback window — ask CloudForge to hold announcement for 48 hours. If they refuse, we must have a fallback lane: runtime auto-route to hosted fallback model in region eu-west-1.
en gie-bot: deploybot: created branch hotfix/marketplace-driver-pin-421999. CI pipeline triggered.
mira: timeline: build AMI by 09:00 PT tomorrow, smoke by 12:00 PT, marketplace update by 16:00 PT. CloudForge comms draft by EOD today.
juan: seq of commands for AMI smoke — putting here for visibility:
```
sudo modprobe nvidia
python -c "import nvml; nvml.nvmlInit(); print(nvml.nvmlSystemGetDriverVersion())"
./redwood-inference-smoke --model gpt-small --tokens 512 --concurrency 4
```
sam: I'll produce signed debs and checksums and upload to partner bucket. Tagging @marketplace-team on access perms.
marketplace-team: granted temporary write to cloudforge-partner/bundles/hotfix/ until 4320000000.
li: can we also get a quick regression test for ROCm path? CloudForge has a few AMD hosts.
mira: yes — add ROCm sanity: run embedding-smoke with rocm backend and compare latencies < 95th percentile baseline.
ben: action items summary (for internal tracking):
- juan: build AMI + run smoke (due tomorrow 12:00 PT)
- sam: create signed debs + checksum manifest (due tomorrow 09:00 PT)
- li: update marketplace compat matrix + runtime fallback toggle (due tomorrow 16:00 PT)
- mira: draft CloudForge comms + rollback window ask (due today EOD)
- ben: coordinate SI handoff notes + air-gapped instructions (due tomorrow 10:00 PT)

mira: also note regression triage plan: if new AMI still fails, we escalate to vendor-partner with kernel bisect + core dump. Keep support channel open with CloudForge devops.
juan: will attach smoke logs to the ticket: CF-1142.
sam: +1 — I'll prepare the deb upload script:
```
#!/bin/bash
set -e
dpkg-deb --build redwood-driver-535.46.01
sha256sum *.deb > checksums.txt
gsutil cp *.deb checksums.txt gs://cloudforge-partner/bundles/hotfix/
```
li: leaving a note for downstream SIs: 'For air-gapped installs use pinned debs from bundle; do not use distro-provided meta-package.'
marketplace-team: CloudForge PM replied: 'OK to freeze announcement for 48h. We'll wait for your go/no-go.'
mira: thanks — will post status here after each milestone. Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept ownership of items.
sam: :thumbsup:
juan: :thumbsup:  
li: :thumbsup:  
ben: :thumbsup:  
engie-bot: incident-bot: created ticket CF-1142-hotfix-driver-pin and linked to run 99321."
